proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3245 *kuḍa explicitly gives Palula kuṛī “woman, wife” and Awan kuṛī “woman”. The article debates deeper Munda/Dravidian origin; this link is to the documented Indo-Aryan family, not a claim to have settled the ultimate source. Joint comparison: awan kuṛī “wife” matches reviewed Phal kūṛī “wife” (f_4myadbaar2tbs). The shared family is provisionally linked under the user’s preference; inheritance versus intra-IA borrowing is not resolved by this formal comparison.
